$meta.method: all 3,097 URLs from the Yoast sitemap index, fetched and parsed for img/src, srcset, lazy-load attrs, <picture><source>, <video>/poster, inline background-image url(), and og/twitter meta images. WordPress resize variants (-WxH) are folded onto the original upload.

tiers.chrome: appears on >1000 pages — site furniture: logo, favicons, header banner, hotline/map/clock glyphs, language flags
tiers.marketing: referenced by a page-sitemap page, a /dich-vu/ service page or a category page — the brand-relevant photography, before/after galleries and review videos
tiers.editorial: appears only on blog posts — the SEO long tail

bytes_probed.note: editorial tier was not probed; at the marketing mean it is roughly 1.6 GB
